name: Greater Shot on the Run (Combat)
body:
You are a moving hurricane of arrows.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Acrobatic Steps, Dodge, Improved Shot on the Run, Mobility, Nimble Moves, Shot on the Run, base attack bonus +16.

Benefit(s): When you use Shot on the Run, you can select three targets to attack during your movement instead of one. The second attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 5, and the third attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 10. All restrictions of Shot on the Run apply to each target, and your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from any of your targets. You can’t target the same creature more than once. You must be able to make multiple attacks in a round with the weapon used.
